# vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp

## Overview

[`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1) implements the GLSL `textureGather` coverage registered as `glsl.texture_gather`. The file registers both `graphics` and `compute` pipeline roots, then expands gather function variants, offset-range variants, texture targets, formats, texture sizes, comparison modes, wrap-mode pairs, sparse variants when not building Vulkan SC, texture-swizzle cases, filter-mode cases, and base-level / AMD LOD-bias cases from nested loops in [`TextureGatherTests::init()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2821-L3135).

## Role

Registration / dispatcher file and implementation-heavy test file.

## Source Code

- Primary source: [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1)
- Header: [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.hpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.hpp#L1)
- GLSL category attachment: [`vktTestPackage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/vktTestPackage.cpp#L1270-L1271)
- Shared shader-render harness: [`vktShaderRender.hpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRender.hpp#L85-L140)

## Registration Hierarchy

```text
glsl.texture_gather
├── graphics
└── compute
```

## Test Families

### graphics — Fragment-shader texture gather cases

The `graphics` branch is created when `useCompute` is false in the two-iteration pipeline loop, and `TextureGatherTests::init()` adds it under `texture_gather` before generating identical gather/texture/format subtrees for that pipeline mode at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2852-L2862). Program generation for graphics cases emits one shared vertex shader plus per-iteration fragment shaders named `frag_N`, using generated `textureGather*` calls in [`genGatherPrograms()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2084-L2099). Execution selects `vert` and the current `frag_N` before rendering a two-triangle quad at [`TextureGatherInstance::iterate()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1465-L1497).

Under `graphics`, the direct generated gather-type children are `basic`, `offset`, `offset_dynamic`, and `offsets`, matching the enum-to-name mapping in [`gatherTypeName()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L818-L858). `basic` is registered directly below the gather-type group because it is the only gather type paired with `OFFSETSIZE_NONE`; non-basic gather types receive `min_required_offset` and `implementation_offset` subgroups from the offset-size loop at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2864-L2879). Cube-map cases are generated only for `basic`, because the texture-type loop skips `TEXTURETYPE_CUBE` for all other gather types at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2881-L2890), and the cube case factory asserts `GATHERTYPE_BASIC` plus `OFFSETSIZE_NONE` at [`makeTextureGatherCase()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2782-L2787).

Each format branch includes regular wrap/size cases and then, for selected offset/gather combinations, extra `texture_swizzle`, `filter_mode`, and `base_level` groups. Regular cases iterate `size_pot` / `size_npot`, depth-only `compare_less` / `compare_greater` groups, and three wrap-pair names before adding a normal case and, outside Vulkan SC builds, a `sparse_` case at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2909-L2965). Extra groups are skipped for `min_required_offset` except when the gather type is `offsets`, an intentional reduction noted in the registration condition at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2971-L2974). Texture swizzle cases are generated only for non-depth formats and are skipped entirely in the compute pipeline at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2975-L3013).

### compute — Compute-shader texture gather cases

The `compute` branch is the same top-level registration loop with `useCompute` true at [`TextureGatherTests::init()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2852-L2856). For compute cases, `genGatherPrograms()` emits per-iteration compute shaders named `comp_N` instead of vertex/fragment shader pairs at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2101-L2115). `TextureGatherInstance::setupUniforms()` supplies padded quad coordinates through a uniform buffer when `useCompute` is true, so the compute path uses the same logical texture-coordinate quad as the graphics path but transports it through uniforms rather than vertex attributes at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1542-L1560).

The compute subtree uses the same generated gather types, offset-size subgroups, texture types, formats, sizes, comparison modes, wrap-pair cases, filter-mode cases, and base-level cases as the graphics subtree where the registration loops allow them. One visible asymmetry is that texture-swizzle groups are not registered for compute, because the non-depth swizzle block immediately continues when `useCompute` is true at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2975-L2979). Sparse compute cases are generated with the same `#ifndef CTS_USES_VULKANSC` guards as sparse graphics cases at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2957-L2965), [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L3066-L3073), and [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L3118-L3125).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Observed values / evidence |
|---|---|
| Pipeline root | `graphics` and `compute` are generated by the two-value `useComputeI` loop at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2852-L2856) |
| Gather type | `basic`, `offset`, `offset_dynamic`, and `offsets` from [`GatherType`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L818-L826) and [`gatherTypeName()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L842-L858) |
| Offset size | `none`, `min_required_offset`, and `implementation_offset`; only `basic` pairs with `none`, while non-basic gather types pair with the two offset subgroups at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L833-L840) and [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2864-L2879) |
| Offset ranges | Minimum-required offsets use `[-8, 7]`; implementation offsets use `minTexelGatherOffset` / `maxTexelGatherOffset`; compile-time `textureGatherOffsets` implementation-maximum vectors use `[-32, 31]` and require support for that range at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L71-L79), [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1164-L1177), and [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1044-L1056) |
| Texture type | `2d`, `2d_array`, and `cube`; cube is skipped for non-basic gather types at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2823-L2827) and [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2881-L2886) |
| Format | `rgba8`, `rgba8ui`, `rgba8i`, and `depth32f` from the `formats[]` table at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2829-L2836) |
| Texture size | `size_pot` uses `IVec3(64, 64, 3)` and `size_npot` uses `IVec3(17, 23, 3)` at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2838-L2842) |
| Comparison mode | Non-depth formats use no compare group; `depth32f` uses `compare_less` and `compare_greater`, with other compare modes filtered out at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2917-L2938) |
| Wrap pairs | Three paired names are generated from `clamp_to_edge`, `repeat`, and `mirrored_repeat`, pairing each `wrapS` with the next `wrapT` entry at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2844-L2850) and [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2940-L2956) |
| Component iterations | Non-depth cases test explicit components `0..3` plus implicit component `0`; depth cases test one component case; AMD bias mode skips the implicit case at [`generateBasic2DCaseIterations()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L996-L1007) |
| Array layers | 2D-array instances include layer `0` for all basic iterations and one selected iteration for layers `-1`, `1`, `2`, and `3`, including out-of-bounds layer indices at [`generate2DArrayCaseIterations()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2302-L2339) |
| Cube faces | Cube instances include all basic iterations for the first face and one selected iteration for each remaining cube face at [`generateCubeCaseIterations()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2528-L2565) |
| Cube corner flag | Cube formats create a normal path and a `no_corners` subgroup; `no_corners` sets `GATHERCASE_DONT_SAMPLE_CUBE_CORNERS`, and non-cube textures do not use that flag at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L828-L831) and [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2898-L2907) |
| Texture swizzle | Six generated swizzle names rotate `TEXTURESWIZZLECOMPONENT_*` values and are registered only for graphics, non-depth cases at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2975-L3013) |
| Filter mode | `filter_mode` combines five min-filter entries with `linear` / `nearest` mag filters, but skips redundant nearest cases and restricts integer formats to `min_nearest_mipmap_nearest_mag_nearest` at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L3015-L3074) |
| Base level and LOD-bias mode | `base_level` generates `level_1` and `level_2`, and outside Vulkan SC also generates `_amd_bias` and `_amd_lod` suffixes except for depth formats at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L3077-L3127) |

## Support / Feature Requirements

| Requirement | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Shader image gather extended | All 2D, 2D-array, and cube test cases call `context.requireDeviceCoreFeature(DEVICE_CORE_FEATURE_SHADER_IMAGE_GATHER_EXTENDED)` in their `checkSupport()` methods at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2275-L2287), [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2501-L2513), and [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2735-L2739) |
| Extended gather syntax in generated shaders | `offset_dynamic`, `offsets`, and `implementation_offset` cases request `GL_EXT_gpu_shader5` in shader sources through `requireGpuShader5()` at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L860-L865), and runtime initialization rejects devices without `shaderImageGatherExtended` when that helper returns true at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1288-L1294) |
| Portability subset mutable comparison samplers | When not building Vulkan SC, depth-compare cases require `mutableComparisonSamplers` if `VK_KHR_portability_subset` is present at [`checkMutableComparisonSamplersSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1145-L1162) |
| Implementation offset limits | `implementation_offset` logs and checks that reported gather offset limits include the minimum required range `[-8, 7]`; `offsets.implementation_offset` additionally requires support for `[-32, 31]` in 2D and 2D-array cases at [`TextureGatherInstance::init()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1302-L1314), [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2280-L2286), and [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2506-L2512) |
| AMD texture gather bias/lod extension | `level_1_amd_bias`, `level_2_amd_bias`, `level_1_amd_lod`, and `level_2_amd_lod` cases require `VK_AMD_texture_gather_bias_lod`, emit `GL_AMD_texture_gather_bias_lod`, and query `VkTextureLODGatherFormatPropertiesAMD::supportsTextureGatherLODBiasAMD` for the selected format and image parameters at [`TextureGatherInstance::init()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1296-L1361), [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1710-L1712), and [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1797-L1799) |
| Sparse variants | Sparse variants are registered only in non-Vulkan SC builds via `#ifndef CTS_USES_VULKANSC`; the sparse image backing mode is passed into `makeTextureGatherCase()` for regular wrap, swizzle, filter, and base-level sparse cases at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2957-L2965), [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L3004-L3011), [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L3066-L3073), and [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L3118-L3125) |
| Cube gather restriction | Cube cases are generated only for `basic` gather and `none` offset, with registration skip logic and factory assertions at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2881-L2886) and [`makeTextureGatherCase()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2782-L2787) |

## Verification Methods

- Each iteration renders or dispatches one quad, obtains the result image, calls the concrete instance verifier, and fails the case with `Result verification failed` when verification returns false at [`TextureGatherInstance::iterate()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1459-L1513).
- Verification builds a `PixelOffsets` helper from the active gather type: zero/single offsets for `basic` and `offset`, dynamic offset ranges for `offset_dynamic`, and four independent offsets for `offsets` at [`makePixelOffsetsFunctor()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L889-L909) and [`TextureGatherInstance::verify()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1576-L1579).
- Depth-format cases use `verifyGatherOffsetsCompare()` with coordinate/UVW precision, 16 reference bits, an 8-bit result channel minus one bit, `PixelCompareRefZDefault(RENDER_SIZE)`, sampler compare mode, and seamless cube-map sampling at [`TextureGatherInstance::verify()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1581-L1604).
- UNORM cases use `verifyGatherOffsets<float>()` with fixed-point color thresholds, coordinate/UVW precision, and an RGBA compare mask at [`TextureGatherInstance::verify()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1608-L1618).
- Integer cases use `verifyGatherOffsets<uint32_t>()` or `verifyGatherOffsets<int32_t>()` with zero color threshold and the same coordinate/UVW precision and compare mask at [`TextureGatherInstance::verify()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1620-L1634).
- Texture contents are randomized color tiles, swizzled when requested, and then wrapped in the concrete texture view used by each verifier: 2D at [`TextureGather2DInstance::verify()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2207-L2213), 2D-array at [`TextureGather2DArrayInstance::verify()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2433-L2439), and cube at [`TextureGatherCubeInstance::verify()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2666-L2672).

## Test Principles

- The file uses a generated matrix rather than hand-written cases: pipeline, gather type, offset size, texture type, format, optional cube corner behavior, texture size, comparison mode, wrap pair, sparse backing, swizzle, filter, and base-level dimensions are all assembled by nested registration loops in [`TextureGatherTests::init()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2821-L3135).
- The implementation separates shader generation from reference checking: `genGatherPrograms()` emits graphics or compute GLSL according to `useCompute`, while the instance verifier reconstructs reference gather behavior from the texture view, sampler state, coordinates, selected component, and pixel offsets at [`genGatherPrograms()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2045-L2117) and [`TextureGatherInstance::verify()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1564-L1634).
- The generated cases intentionally avoid full Cartesian expansion in several places: extra feature groups are mostly skipped for `min_required_offset`, texture swizzle is graphics-only and non-depth, offset variants are not generated for cube maps, and nonzero array layers / non-first cube faces use one selected iteration rather than duplicating every component and offset case at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2971-L2979), [`generate2DArrayCaseIterations()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2310-L2337), and [`generateCubeCaseIterations()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L2535-L2563).
- Support gating is layered: static registration guards remove sparse and AMD level-mode cases from Vulkan SC builds, per-case `checkSupport()` requires core image-gather support and portability-subset comparison-sampler support, and instance initialization performs runtime checks for extended gather syntax, offset limits, AMD extension availability, and AMD per-format properties at [`vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderrender/vktShaderRenderTextureGatherTests.cpp#L1288-L1361).

## Notes / Uncertainties

- The page documents the direct children of `glsl.texture_gather` in the parseable hierarchy. Deeper generated names are described in the normal sections because the registration tree contract expands only one level below the Level-3 root.
- The inspected source shows sparse-case registration through `IMAGE_BACKING_MODE_SPARSE`, but sparse feature checks are inherited from the shared shader-render harness rather than implemented directly in this file.
